protocol.scope: Frozen A100 three FFHQ images x four tasks x sigma_model.05; same observations/operators/seeds/grid.
protocol.accounting: NFE counts denoiser forwards only. ZAPS300=300F/10 optimizer backwards; ZAPS450=450F/15B; response methods=445F/9B/29VJP/29JVP. Operator and wavelet calls separate.
protocol.comparison: Primary same-derivative comparison diagonal445 vs ray445. ZAPS450 is a near-NFE control for extra forwards, not derivative-equivalent. Full method-equivalent clocks are reported.
protocol.pairing: Response arms share exactly one independently reproduced 270F/9B learned prefix, then independently replay the same RNG. ZAPS arms are independent from-seed executions.
protocol.gates: ZAPS300 must reproduce frozen BASE; response arms must reproduce frozen A100 outputs; learned prefix snapshot must reproduce frozen entry. No failed-case retry or quality fallback.
protocol.limits: Small reused development panel. No author benchmark, universal improvement, acceleration or posterior guarantee.
